$comment: Contexts branch protection requires on main. This list mirrors the live rule, so it must change in the same change as the rule, whichever repair is chosen. On 2026-09-26T16:58:50Z ruleset main-2 (24045474) required a bare 'test', which was correct then: the workflow's test job was not yet a matrix. PR #68 merged the support-range matrix at 2026-09-26T21:02:17Z, the emitted names changed, and the requirement became unsatisfiable. The defect DUK-227 tracks. The four entries below are the matrix-job shape, so this file matches repair D. Under repair E the matrix job is renamed and an aggregate job emits 'test', and this list becomes ["test"] in the same pull request. tests/test_required_check_contract.py passes under either shape as long as this list matches the workflow; a mismatch is reported, not assumed.
